# hg event

**What this page tells you:** every `hg event` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The event router: list, trace, publish, prove the queue, dead letters.

## Synopsis

```text
hg event list [flags]
hg event inspect <event>|<binding> [flags]
hg event plan [flags]
hg event payload validate <event> [flags]
hg event publish <event> [flags]
hg event status [<event>] [flags]
hg event queue test [flags]
hg event dlq
hg event dlq replay <deliveryId>
hg event ingress test [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

`list`/`inspect`/`plan`/`payload validate` are OFFLINE; `emit` publishes through the REAL router (schema-gated, waits for queued deliveries to settle); `status` traces receipts.

## `hg event list`

```text
hg event list [flags]
```

Declared events.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo>` | — | The declaring repo. |
| `--environment` | `<file>` | — | The cluster half, overriding the repo's own: a legacy `topology.yaml`-shaped file (targets inline), or an environment spec (`infra/environments/<env>.yaml`) whose `grants` supply targets, DNS, policy and capability providers for the team's target-free `harness-hg/topology.yaml`. Team files (bundles, communication, capabilities) always come from the repo's `harness-hg/` (legacy: `environment/`). |

## `hg event publish`

```text
hg event publish <event> [flags]
```

Publish through the real router; waits for queued deliveries to settle (was: emit).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--payload` | `<file.json>` | — | The event payload. |
| `--from` | `<p>/<app>#<out>` | — | The emitting output binding. |
| `--to-agent` | `<profile>` | — | Deliver to one agent profile. |
| `--to-chatops` | `<space>` | — | Deliver to one ChatOps space. |
| `--correlation` | `<id>` | — | Correlation id threaded through the delivery records. |
| `--ordering-key` | `<k>` | — | Same-key deliveries are FIFO. |
| `--duplicate` | — | — | Send the same delivery twice to prove dedup. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg event list --dir .
hg event publish content.published --payload evt.json --from manager/postiz#published
```

## `hg event queue test`

```text
hg event queue test [flags]
```

Durable acceptance + same-key fifo + cross-key concurrency + an empty dlq.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--count` | `<n>` | `3` | Deliveries per leg. |
| `--ordering-key` | `<k>` | — | Key for the FIFO leg. |
